raw_attributes.value: FRAM Extra Guard® oil filters deliver advanced engine protection for everyday drivers who perform routine oil changes at OE (original equipment) recommended intervals. Equipped with SureGrip® technology, FRAM Extra Guard® oil filters provide a non-slip surface allowing for easy install and removal.\nThe silicone anti-drain back valve ensures safe engine startups, extending the life of the oil filter for up to 10,000 miles (16,000 kilometers).
Engineered for use with synthetic or conventional motor oils
Filter media is a blend of fiber and resin that captures 95% of the dirt particles
SureGrip® technology for easy install and removal
Proven protection for up to 10,000 miles (16,000 kilometers)
Silicone anti-drain back valve helps ensure safe engine start up
Superseded	- Part is being replaced by the surviving part number. PH4967
